latest_bullet_support.rule: Fewer than 20 rated games in this control during the prior year, at least 10 rated games in other controls, and a rating gap of at least 400 Elo. method3.accuracy_role: Only qualifying earlier-history Accuracy increases or corroborated result-review evidence may raise LOW to MODERATE. Absolute Accuracy frequency is descriptive only; never independently raises priority. HIGH requires strict results guards.
method3.limits: Rated and unrated share chronological periods/references, but their Elo reliability is separately audited. Zero rated anchors, cross-control discrepancies and verified new-account rating ramps cap results-backed HIGH/VERY HIGH. Repeated opponents cap these tiers even if Accuracy corroborates. Daily is excluded; only collected live history is searched. Underrating, legitimate improvement, smurfing, rating lag, correlated games, missing archives and selected hot streaks can qualify. VERY HIGH requires both results and matched earlier Accuracy but never proves misconduct.
